# Homer vendored runtime

Copyright 2018 Bastien Wirtz and Homer contributors.
Project: https://github.com/bastienwirtz/homer
Demo: https://homer-demo.netlify.app/
Runtime version: 26.08.3
Retrieved: 2026-11-05

The JavaScript, CSS and five WOFF2 fonts in this directory are unmodified files retrieved from the demo's resources directory. The original hashed filenames are retained. The native generic cards, search, theme switcher, layout toggle and navbar are used through assets/config.yml.

- index-B-z7anWl.js: SHA-256 9dfdfb34f024e6293dc1af852a39d151068e4caadd2cad5175ea1bfd6e9fc076
- index-ncMaiPrF.css: SHA-256 06a1af8fe5753f54173505e39f09ff0ce6c83e229a50fd9cf08ae422dec751a8

The optional smart-card modules, demo API fixtures, alternative-theme wallpapers, PWA manifest and service worker are not included or configured. No remote connectivity check is enabled. The default theme only requests the local files included here.

SoftShelf's index.html and assets/config.yml are site-specific configuration and content. The prior custom CSS and JavaScript implementation has been removed. Download metadata was migrated from software.js into assets/config.yml; the download URLs and package contents are unchanged.
